title: 第一卷 第21章 训练第一卷 第22章 考核
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
“准备好了吗？”
吴川生看着李毅，一脸郑重。
“吴哥，我准备好了，开始吧。”
在得到李毅的确定后，只见吴川生一声令下，同伍的几个老兵，纷纷将手中的笼子打开，哗啦一下，五六只麻雀飞出，冲天而去。
见状，李毅眼眸一凝，拿出破军弓弯弓搭箭，对着天空数次连射，不过几息时间，天空中的麻雀，就吧嗒吧嗒掉落一地。
看着地上抽动的麻雀，李毅微微点头。
在结果这段时间的训练，李毅的杀人之箭，进步很快，连带着射箭技能的经验也增长了许多。
一旁的吴川生看着这一幕，也是露出了满意的笑容。
“十息时间，射杀五只麻雀，不错不错。”
“对于移动靶的训练，你已经差不多都练完了，休息一会，我们进行最后一项训练。”
吴川生将毛巾递给李毅后，便走向一旁的老兵，开始吩咐他们去做最后一项训练的准备。
一刻钟后，吴川生递给了李毅一壶箭。
李毅拿起一看，只见这些箭是用竹子做成的箭杆，箭头上则是包着白布，布团里面包裹着石灰。
这是特制的训练用箭，用力射中目标后，箭头白布里面的石灰会被重力挤压，在目标被射中处，留下一个明显的白点。
“我准备好了，开始吧！”
深吸一口气，李毅将箭壶挂在腰间，目光坚定的望向面前训练的树林。
“那就开始！”
吴川生用力敲击手中的铜锣，只见一瞬间，树林中冲出一队身穿黑衣的壮汉，拿着各种武器，猛然向李毅冲来。
杀！
李毅秒见战斗状态，信手一抹，一只箭就搭在破军弓上。

咻~
箭瞬间射出，啪嗒一声命中一个拿刀大汉的心口，
巨力冲击下，箭杆瞬间断裂，箭头灰尘四溢，一团石灰死死黏在了大汉的黑衣上。
在被箭命中后，大汉一声不吭，径直倒在了地上。
李毅神色不变，快速取出一箭，眨眼间就将藏身在一处灌木丛后的一人命中，使其躺在地上。
咻~
咻~
咻~
接连三声轻响，三个大汉被李毅命中，倒在了地上。
而在树林中，尚且还有十个人，正在向李毅冲来。
必须要加快速度了！
见状，李毅神色一凝，大手在腰间箭壶一抹，两只箭瞬间出现在破军弓上。
“这是要二连射？”
一旁的吴川生看着这一幕，眼眸一缩。
多发同射，这是天赋异禀的神箭手才会的技能。
就连他这个浸淫箭术近十载的老弓兵，也才刚刚掌握二连射！
看着李毅如此娴熟轻松的施展二连射，吴川生不由得暗自叹服。
他没想到，李毅的天赋竟然如此强大。
比他预想之中，强的不是一星半点儿。
咻咻~

一瞬间，只见两个相近的大汉，瞬间被命中要害倒在了地上。
“分散开！”
只见树林深处，传来一声大喝。
一时间，剩下的八个人，接连拉开距离。
content_en:
"Are you ready?"
Wu Chuansheng looked at Li Yi with a solemn expression.
"Angkor, I'm ready, let's get started."
After getting Li Yi's confirmation, Wu Chuansheng gave an order, and several veterans in the same army opened the cages in their hands. With a crash, five or six sparrows flew out and flew into the sky.
Seeing this, Li Yi's eyes narrowed, he took out his Pojun bow, bent it with an arrow, and shot several times into the sky. In just a few breaths, the sparrows in the sky fell to the ground.
Looking at the twitching sparrow on the ground, Li Yi nodded slightly.
During this period of training, Li Yi's murderous arrows improved rapidly, and his experience in archery skills also increased a lot.
Wu Chuansheng on the side looked at this scene and also showed a satisfied smile.
"In ten breaths, shoot five sparrows, not bad."
"You've almost finished the moving target training. Let's take a break and let's do the last training."
After Wu Chuansheng handed the towel to Li Yi, he walked to the veterans aside and began to instruct them to prepare for the last training.
A quarter of an hour later, Wu Chuansheng handed Li Yi a pot of arrows.
Li Yi picked it up and took a look, and saw that these arrows were made of bamboo shafts, and the arrowheads were wrapped in white cloth, and the cloth was wrapped with lime.
This is a specially made training arrow. After hitting the target with force, the lime inside the white cloth of the arrow will be squeezed by gravity, leaving an obvious white spot where the target was hit.
"I'm ready, let's get started!"
Taking a deep breath, Li Yi hung the arrow pot on his waist and looked firmly at the training woods in front of him.
"Then start!"
Wu Chuansheng struck the gong in his hand hard, and for a moment, a group of strong men in black rushed out of the woods, holding various weapons, and suddenly rushed towards Li Yi.
kill!
Li Yi saw the fighting situation in seconds, and with a flick of his hand, an arrow was placed on the Pojun bow.
Phew~
The arrow shot out instantly and hit a big man holding a knife in the heart with a loud bang.
Under the huge impact, the arrow shaft broke instantly, the arrow dust spilled out, and a ball of lime stuck to the big man's black clothes.
After being hit by the arrow, the big man fell to the ground without saying a word.
Li Yi's expression remained unchanged. He quickly took out an arrow and hit a person hiding behind a bush in the blink of an eye, causing him to lie on the ground.
Phew~
Phew~
Phew~
With three soft sounds in succession, the three big men were hit by Li Yi and fell to the ground.
In the woods, there were still ten people rushing towards Li Yi.
We must speed up!
Seeing this, Li Yi's expression condensed, and he touched the arrow pot on his waist with his big hand, and two arrows instantly appeared on Pojun's bow.
"Is this a double shot?"
Wu Chuansheng on the side looked at this scene and his eyes narrowed.
Shooting multiple shots at the same time is a skill only possessed by talented archers.
Even he, a veteran archer who has been immersed in archery for nearly ten years, has just mastered two consecutive shots!
Seeing Li Yi execute the two consecutive shots so skillfully and easily, Wu Chuansheng couldn't help but admire secretly.
He didn't expect that Li Yi's talent was so powerful.
It was not a bit stronger than he expected.
Whoosh~
In an instant, I saw two big men who were close to each other. They were hit in vital parts and fell to the ground.
"Spread out!"
I saw a loud shout coming from deep in the woods.
For a time, the remaining eight people distanced themselves one after another.
